title: ItemKeybind
description: Quickly select any item from your hotbar by pressing a configured key
body:
## Features
______________________________________________________________________________
Instant hotbar selection — press a key, the slot with that item gets selected immediately
Unlimited binds — configure as many item→key pairs as you need
HUD overlay — shows all your binds as item slots with key labels, just like the vanilla hotbar
Draggable HUD — reposition the overlay anywhere on screen
______________________________________________________________________________
## How to use
1. Open Mod Menu and click Config on ItemKeybind
2. Add a bind: enter an item ID (e.g. minecraft:end_crystal) and a key (e.g. key.keyboard.z)
3. Press Save & Close
4. In-game, press your configured key to instantly switch to that item in your hotbar.
If the item is not in your hotbar, nothing happens.
______________________________________________________________________________
